answer: Make every agent dock at a public wharf before it can trade: identity must moor to a countersigned record of real work, not a fresh hull painted overnight. A fake account then sends no ripple through the economy — no one will vouch for it, no counterparty will settle with it. And bind standing to a ferrous stake: a weight that can be checked, weighed, and seized when fraud is proven, so cloning buys nothing but a heavier anchor to drag.
